data.name: Elixir of Life
data.description: Once per day, you can brew an elixir of life. This special concoction costs 25,000 gp to create and takes 1 hour of work. An elixir of life, when administered by the Investigator who brewed it, restores life to a dead creature as per the spell true resurrection. Alternatively, you may drink the elixir of life yourself, after which point you are immediately targeted with a resurrection spell the next time you are killed. Used in this manner, the effects of an elixir of life persist only for a number of days equal to your Intelligence modifier; if you do not die before that time expires, the effects of the elixir of life end.
